findings.disposition_reason: lens-security round 2: checks.py:529-537 reads two bytes as bytes, refuses non-files, catches OSError; dangling symlink, directory symlink, mode-0 file and FIFO all return False without raising
findings.message: The shebang probe reads every no-suffix changed path with `read_text` — the whole file, text mode, only FileNotFoundError caught: a binary no-suffix file (`bin/blob`, a `.DS_Store`) raises UnicodeDecodeError and a submodule path raises IsADirectoryError, and the top-level handler turns either into exit 3 "this is a bug in aegis" on the task gate and the pre-push hook. A multi-GB blob is also loaded into memory to inspect two bytes; the change-kind detector at flow.py:617 already guards the same read with `_is_binary` and `except UnicodeDecodeError`.
findings.minimal_fix: `os.path.isfile(full) and open(full, "rb").read(2) == b"#!"` inside a try/except OSError

findings.disposition_reason: lens-security round 2: flow.py:381 now agrees with the header; the path both promise is refused by task_new — recorded as the correctness sev-2 at scaffold.py:41
findings.message: The constitution header now says an agent amends it through a task, while the task packet at flow.py:381 still tells the builder "Do not edit `.aegis/constitution.md`" and nothing in the diff enforces either. Two instructions to the same agent disagree; which one it follows decides whether a task owning the constitution is refused or lands unchecked.
findings.minimal_fix: align the packet line with the header: "edit `.aegis/constitution.md` only when the task owns it"

findings.message: `init` opens README by name without checking it is a regular file inside the checkout, so a README that is a symlink to a local path outside the repository (a cloned repository can carry one) writes that file's first paragraph into `.aegis/constitution.md`, which is then committed and pushed. Dominated by the stated trust model — the gate already runs the repository's own commands — so an observation, not a control the diff owes.
findings.minimal_fix: skip the name when `os.path.islink(path)` or `os.path.realpath(path)` is outside `ctx.root`
